clue.text: From many a unit exact quarter

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, so a large number
I is the Roman numeral for one, a single unit
exact means strict, as in a strict interpretation

explanation.surface: Somebody precisely measures out a quarter from a block of many units.
explanation.walkthrough: Roman numerals supply the opening: D (500, 'many') and I (one, 'a unit').
explanation.definitionFit: A quarter of a town is a neighbourhood or area, the same idea as a district.

clue.text: Directive given after 'the underworld causes unrest

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm
a directive is an order

explanation.surface: An instruction from the criminal underworld stirs up trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given after' is the charade's order signal; 'underworld' suggests gangsters but means the Roman god's realm.
explanation.definitionFit: Unrest means public disturbance and riot, a lack of calm.

clue.text: Where to discard a banger

parts.note: a banger looks like a sausage but is British slang for an old worn-out car, dumped where junk goes

explanation.walkthrough: A banger is British slang for a sausage and also for an old battered car.
explanation.definitionFit: Old cars that no longer run end up on a pile of waste metal.

clue.text: Reins tangled up

indicators.note: tangled says the letters of reins are knotted into a new order

explanation.surface: A rider's reins get knotted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tangled' makes RISEN from REINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Having got up from bed or from the dead is to be up.

clue.text: Event in which the outsider falls

indicators.note: in which places the outsider inside the event

parts.note: a case is an instance or event
a cad is a bounder, a social outsider

explanation.surface: A race where the long-shot runner tumbles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outsider' suggests a long-shot horse but means a cad, a man who behaves dishonourably.
explanation.definitionFit: A cascade is a waterfall, so falls of water.

clue.text: Decide not to move again?

explanation.surface: Someone resolves to stay put after one move too many.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle an argument is to decide it; to settle somewhere is to make a home and stop moving.

clue.text: Shouted out at one time and made allegations

parts.note: ex means former, as at one time
claimed means asserted or alleged

explanation.surface: Someone once cried out while making accusations.
explanation.definitionFit: To cry out loudly in surprise is to yell.

clue.text: Judge rank to be about right

indicators.note: to be about says the rank word goes around the letter for right

parts.note: a tier is a rank or row

explanation.surface: A judge's rank seems about right.
explanation.definitionFit: A trier is one who tries a case, like a judge in court.

clue.text: A potential high-flier for example receiving a grant

indicators.note: receiving says the abbreviation for example takes in the article

parts.note: to let is to allow or grant

explanation.surface: A promising young star receives a bursary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'high-flier' suggests a gifted student, but it is a young bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A young eagle may grow into a bird that soars at great height.

clue.text: Family junk

explanation.surface: A household full of rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: A litter is a family of young animals born together; litter is also rubbish strewn about.

clue.text: Fathers showing exasperation in — a sea-going vessel

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the vessel's abbreviation

parts.note: SS stands for steamship, a sea-going vessel
ire is anger or exasperation

explanation.surface: Dads lose their tempers aboard a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To sire a child is to father it, so sires are male parents, especially of horses.

clue.text: Punishment for deviation

explanation.surface: Someone is caned for straying from the rules.
explanation.definitionFit: A switching is a beating with a thin cane; switching also means changing course or shifting direction.

clue.text: Tear around to express thanks, being conscience-stricken

indicators.note: around says the tear word wraps the other two pieces

parts.note: a tear in cloth is a rent
to express in writing is to pen
TA is British slang for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone rushes about saying thank you because they feel guilty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tear around' reads as rushing about, but 'Tear' is a rip in cloth and 'around' is the container signal; 'express' means write, not speak.
explanation.definitionFit: A person stricken by conscience feels remorse, which is to be sorry for sins.

clue.text: A stretch of water where 8 would feel at home

parts.note: Lake Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A lake where a young bird might be comfortable.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 refers to 8-down, a young eagle, whose home is the nest named here.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyrie is the high nest of an eagle, the natural home of an eaglet.

clue.text: Solitary before time changed him

parts.note: ere is an old word meaning before

indicators.note: changed signals that the letters of time are rearranged

explanation.surface: A loner was different before time altered him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' makes MITE from TIME.
explanation.definitionFit: A solitary, as a noun, is a recluse, one living alone for religious reasons like a hermit.

clue.text: Not even the sort to fight for a cause

definitions.text: the sort to fight for a cause

explanation.surface: Not even the type of person to stand up for anything.
explanation.definitionFit: Irregular means uneven; an irregular is also a soldier outside the regular army, a guerrilla.

clue.text: The traveller needs endless capital, no matter what

indicators.note: endless removes the final letter of the capital city

parts.note: Rome is the Italian capital
any, as in any one at all, no matter which

explanation.surface: A wanderer always needs cash regardless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money, but it is the city ROME, trimmed by 'endless' to ROM.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roma people are traditionally nomadic, and one of them is a traveller.

clue.text: Keeping very quiet, sees lions in proper setting

indicators.note: in proper setting tells us the letters of sees lions are put in their correct order

explanation.surface: A hushed watcher sees lions in their natural habitat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in proper setting' makes the answer from SEES LIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Making no sound at all is silent.

clue.text: Check when others come down

parts.note: the rest means the others
rain comes down from the sky

explanation.surface: Someone checks whether the others are coming downstairs.
explanation.definitionFit: To check something is to hold it back.

clue.text: Points heavenward

parts.note: reads as a verb phrase about pointing upward, but describes the tall pointed tops of churches as a noun

explanation.definitionFit: Church steeples taper to a point aimed at the sky.

clue.text: The way to call for a tie-up

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
to ring is to telephone or call

explanation.surface: How to arrange a merger by phone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tie-up' suggests a business deal but means something to tie with.
explanation.definitionFit: Cord used to tie a parcel up is twine.

clue.text: Finally become sensible and upright

parts.note: in the end means finally
wise means sensible

explanation.surface: Someone at last grows sensible and honest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upright' looks like moral uprightness, but here means standing on end.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing on its end is the same as standing vertical.

clue.text: Artists eating out

parts.note: reads as painters dining in a restaurant, but describes printmakers whose acid eats lines into metal plates

explanation.definitionFit: Printmakers who use acid to bite designs into metal are a kind of artist.

clue.text: Bad spirit is shown over wild-cat strike

indicators.note: in a down clue, over puts the first piece above the second

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous spirit

indicators.note: wild says the letters of cat run free into a new order

explanation.surface: A devil is behind an unofficial walkout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild-cat strike' reads as an unofficial walkout; 'wild' makes ACT from CAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Impact is a collision, a hitting of one thing against another.

clue.text: A woman doctor seen by the gutter press

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, a doctor
a rag is a low-quality newspaper

explanation.surface: A female physician is photographed by the tabloids.
explanation.definitionFit: Morag is a Scottish girl's name, so it names one particular woman.

clue.text: Steal in and get the bird

parts.note: to rob is to steal

explanation.surface: A burglar breaks in and is booed off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get the bird' is a British idiom for being booed, but here 'the bird' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The robin is a small red-breasted songbird.

clue.text: Don't forget about prayer

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a collect is a short prayer in Christian liturgy

explanation.surface: A reminder to keep someone's prayer in mind.
explanation.walkthrough: A collect is a short set prayer in church services.
explanation.definitionFit: To remember something is not to forget it, and to call it back to mind.

clue.text: It's all up with many a beast

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word all is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: It's all over for a crowd of animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ALL into LLA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A South American pack animal is a beast.

clue.text: A mean club, may well provide such transport

indicators.note: may well provide hints that these letters could be arranged into something new

explanation.surface: A stingy social club might lay on a vehicle for its members.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may well provide' makes AMBULANCE from A MEAN CLUB; 'such transport' points back to the whole clue.
explanation.definitionFit: An emergency vehicle that carries the sick or injured to hospital is a kind of transport.

clue.text: Lists some rare natural phenomena

indicators.note: some means only part of the words rare natural is used

explanation.surface: Some unusual natural phenomena are described.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lists' looks like a verb but is the old noun for the ground where knights jousted.
explanation.definitionFit: The lists were the enclosed ground for jousting tournaments, a place of combat like a stadium.

clue.text: Holding catch, return it to the river

indicators.note: return means the word for catch is read backwards

parts.note: to net is to catch
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, England

explanation.surface: An angler holds a catch and puts it back in the river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns NET into TEN; the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: A holding of land or office is the period or right of possession.

clue.text: Putting simpletons inside is criminal!

parts.note: an ass is a fool, so two of them make simpletons
in means inside

explanation.surface: Locking up fools is outrageous!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Putting ... inside' suggests a container, but it is a plain charade of two ASSes and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A hired killer is a kind of criminal.
